profile.intro: I’m a designer and researcher with a B.Sc. in Computer Science & Engineering from Green University of Bangladesh. I have worked across three companies — shaping clear interfaces, strong visuals and meaningful data stories — and I’m happiest when I’m exploring somewhere new.
